title: Versions & upgrades
hint: When each cluster will be auto-upgraded by GKE, to which version, and how much support life remains. Read-only — upgrades are executed in the cloud console.
notSynced: Upgrade information for this cluster was not collected
notSyncedUnknown: Collection did not succeed and no reason was recorded. Without this data, "no upgrade scheduled" is not a valid conclusion — it can be auto-upgraded at any time.

field.versionDrift: differs from control plane (nodes not upgraded yet)
field.poolsUnknown: Node pools not collected (does not mean there are none)

empty.title: No cluster upgrade information retrieved
empty.reason: No GKE clusters are managed yet, or the cloud credential is missing. Managed clusters are auto-upgraded by Google on their release channel, and without this data you cannot see when that will happen.

error.title: Upgrade information could not be loaded

baseline.needSync: This cluster has not been collected successfully, so a baseline taken now cannot be compared against afterwards

schedule.title: GKE version schedule
schedule.desc: Auto-upgrade dates per channel. Manual overrides are only needed when parsing the official page breaks.
schedule.precisionNote: Google publishes many of these at month or quarter granularity (2026-09 / 2026-Q4). Read the precision — do not schedule a maintenance window off a month-level date.
schedule.overrideDesc: A fallback for when the official page changes shape and parsing breaks. Normally you should not touch it.
schedule.rawHint: Enter it as published: 2026-09-15 for an exact date, 2026-09 for a month, 2026-Q4 for a quarter.
schedule.precisionHint: Decides how the date is interpreted. Entering 2026-09 but marking it as day makes it read as September 1st.
schedule.pinWarning: An override pins this row: the scheduled sync stops updating it, so later changes on the official page will not appear here. Clear the override once the official page is parsing correctly again.
schedule.searchPlaceholder: Search version or channel, e.g. 1.36 / stable
schedule.noMatch: No schedule rows match "{{kw}}". It may not be published yet, or filtered out by "only relevant" above

detail.subtitle: Control plane {{version}}
detail.reasonUnparsed: Repair reason could not be parsed (raw text below)
detail.livePolling: Refreshes every 15s; stops when this drawer closes
detail.collectionBroken: Collection is currently broken — “no events” is not a valid conclusion
detail.noEvents: No node version changes in this window. If collection is flagged broken above, this does not mean nothing happened.
detail.extrapolate: How to extrapolate these numbers to other clusters
detail.pdbNotCollected: PDBs were not collected — “nothing blocking” is not a valid conclusion
detail.extraNodes: {{n}} extra nodes during the upgrade (check quota)
detail.incomplete: Only a range is possible — missing: {{list}}

nodeHealth.title: Node health and auto-repair
nodeHealth.hint: GKE auto-repair drains and rebuilds a node with no notification — this is the only place you can see it coming.
nodeHealth.notWatching: Not being watched — “no problems” below is not a valid conclusion
